crossRefs.note: Because I delivered the poor who cried, and the fatherless also, who had no one to help him,
I delight to do your will, my God. Yes, your law is within my heart.”
Praise Yah! Blessed is the man who fears Yahweh, who delights greatly in his commandments.
I will delight myself in your statutes. I will not forget your word.
Unless your law had been my delight, I would have perished in my affliction.
I know that there is nothing better for them than to rejoice, and to do good as long as they live.
You meet him who rejoices and does righteousness, those who remember you in your ways. Behold, you were angry, and we…
Jesus said to them, “My food is to do the will of him who sent me and to accomplish his work.
For I delight in God’s law after the inward man,
The Righteous One considers the house of the wicked, and brings the wicked to ruin.
For why should you, my son, be captivated with an adulteress? Why embrace the bosom of another?
The way of Yahweh is a stronghold to the upright, but it is a destruction to the workers of iniquity.
Then I will tell them, ‘I never knew you. Depart from me, you who work iniquity.’
The Son of Man will send out his angels, and they will gather out of his Kingdom all things that cause stumbling, and…
and will cast them into the furnace of fire. There will be the weeping and the gnashing of teeth.
He will say, ‘I tell you, I don’t know where you come from. Depart from me, all you workers of iniquity.’
There will be weeping and gnashing of teeth when you see Abraham, Isaac, Jacob, and all the prophets in God’s Kingdom…

translations.web: It is joy to the righteous to do justice; but it is a destruction to the workers of iniquity.
translations.bsb: Justice executed is a joy to the righteous, but a terror to the workers of iniquity.
translations.kjv: It is joy to the just to do judgment: but destruction shall be to the workers of iniquity.
translations.asv: It is joy to the righteous to do justice; But it is a destruction to the workers of iniquity.
